dct_description_sm: Biopsy samples (skin and occassionally blubber) were collected from free-ranging bowhead whales (Balaena mysticetus) using a crossbow and specialized bolt. Samples were collected as part of a photo-identification project to determine sex of photo-identified bowhead whales and will be added to a general genetic database maintained by DFO. Samples are also being used for studies on bowhead foraging using fatty acid and stable isotope analyses, and genetic capture-mark-recapture estimates of population size.
dct_title_s: Bowhead whale (Balaena mysticetus) biopsy samples - Foxe Basin and Repulse Bay
